name: ClaimPrism
author: parsec66

sections.description:
ClaimPrism is a local-first risk-screening and claim-governance tool for WordPress and WooCommerce.

The Free edition scans supported products, pages, posts, common SEO metadata and image alt text for deterministic environmental-marketing risk signals, then prioritizes findings for human review. It includes first-run onboarding, resumable full-store scans and clear post-scan guidance.

ClaimPrism Pro extends detection into an operational governance workflow with:

  • persistent review states, reviewer assignment, internal notes and append-only review history;
  • scalable review filters, bulk review actions and workflow-aware CSV export;
  • Evidence Repository with supporting references, notes and review/expiry dates;
  • scan monitoring with New / Recurring / Removed classification and history;
  • scheduled scans and operational review reports;
  • dedicated Reviewer and Manager roles;
  • stable Governed Claim identity and lifecycle metadata;
  • Claim Graph usage intelligence across known claim usages;
  • Approved Claim Library views;
  • deterministic Semantic Drift signals;
  • precise Claim Source Location context;
  • controlled approved-wording reuse proposals;
  • a dedicated Claim Governance workspace combining lifecycle, usages, review/evidence context, approved wording and monitoring signals.

ClaimPrism follows an internal governance lifecycle:

Detected -> Evidence required -> In review -> Approved -> Monitoring -> Re-review

These are workflow states. ClaimPrism does not certify claims, determine legal compliance or provide legal advice. Automated findings can include false positives and always require human review.

Privacy

Claim scanning remains local to WordPress and scanned content is not sent to an external ClaimPrism analysis service. ClaimPrism uses the Freemius SDK for optional usage opt-in, licensing, account management, updates and checkout. The SDK presents the applicable consent and account controls in WordPress before optional telemetry is enabled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the claimprism folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install its ZIP package.
  2. Activate ClaimPrism.
  3. In WooCommerce, open WooCommerce > ClaimPrism. Without WooCommerce, use Tools > ClaimPrism.
  4. Follow the first-run guidance and select “Scan store now” or “Run your first scan”.
  5. Review detected findings. Pro users can continue into Review, Evidence, Monitoring and Claim Governance workflows.
sections.faq:
Does ClaimPrism guarantee compliance?

No. ClaimPrism is an automated risk-screening and workflow tool. Legal assessment depends on the exact claim, evidence, presentation, jurisdiction and surrounding circumstances.

What does the Free edition do?

The Free edition provides the core scan and prioritization experience so you can identify supported environmental marketing signals that may deserve human attention. It remains useful without a purchase.

What does ClaimPrism Pro add?

Pro adds the operational workflow around findings: reviewer assignment, review history, evidence management, monitoring, scheduled scans, reports, team roles and the Claim Governance workspace for managing governed claims and their known usages over time.

Does an Approved claim mean ClaimPrism has certified it?

No. Approved is an internal governance state recorded by the user’s workflow. It is not a certification or legal-compliance verdict.

Is catalog content sent to Freemius?

No. Claim scanning is performed locally. Freemius handles product telemetry only after the applicable opt-in, plus licensing, account, update and purchase functions.
sections.changelog:
0.10.0

  • Add dedicated ClaimPrism Reviewer and ClaimPrism Manager WordPress roles with narrowly scoped ClaimPrism capabilities.
  • Add persistent Governed Claim identity and lifecycle metadata around detected claim usages.
  • Add Review/Evidence aggregate views and Claim Graph usage intelligence without duplicating source-of-truth workflow data.
  • Add Approved Claim Library, deterministic Semantic Drift signals and controlled approved-wording reuse proposals.
  • Add precise Claim Source Location resolution for supported WordPress/WooCommerce source fields.
  • Add the dedicated Pro Claim Governance workspace exposing lifecycle, usages, review/evidence context, approved wording and drift signals.
  • Align the main dashboard and Claim Governance workspace to the dark ZEODEC visual system.
  • Add first-run onboarding, Free-to-Pro value communication and improved post-scan empty-state guidance.
  • Preserve Free/Pro boundaries and non-certification wording throughout the commercial workflow.

0.9.0

  • Add Pro scan monitoring with first seen, last seen, recurrence counts, active/removed state and New / Recurring / Removed classification.
  • Add scan-run history and comparison summaries plus finding-level monitoring filters and history drill-down.
  • Add a Pro Evidence Repository with external references, WordPress media attachments, internal notes and expiry/review-date status.
  • Add configurable Pro scheduled scans with Disabled, Daily, Weekly and Every 30 days frequencies plus preferred local hour.
  • Add 7 / 30 / 90 day Pro Review Reports with protected CSV export covering finding changes, review state and evidence due/expiry metrics.
  • Add protected bulk review actions for status and reviewer changes while preserving internal notes and append-only audit history.
  • Replace the 100-row in-memory Pro queue with database-backed filtering/counting and 50-row pagination across the complete findings set.
  • Keep all new commercial workflow modules behind Freemius premium-only boundaries and extend automated regression coverage.

0.8.0

  • Add a Pro review workflow with persistent Open, In review, Resolved and Accepted states keyed to finding fingerprints so review state survives rescans.
  • Add internal reviewer notes, WordPress-user assignment and append-only review history with actor and timestamp.
  • Add Pro queue filters for status, priority, reviewer, content type, rule and free-text search, preserving active filters after review updates.
  • Add workflow-aware filtered Pro CSV export including status, reviewer, internal note and review timestamp while retaining spreadsheet-injection protection.
  • Add Free/Pro package regression, upgrade-persistence and workflow coverage; WordPress + WooCommerce integration tests and official Plugin Check pass on the generated package.

0.7.7

  • Resume interrupted background scans after plugin reactivation and retry safely after lock contention.
  • Keep background scan scheduling idempotent across repeated starts and multi-batch progression.
  • Clear stale continuation events when scans finish and start completed scans again with fresh counters and content totals.
  • Expand automated regression coverage for scan persistence, Free/Pro boundaries, upgrade safety and release metadata alignment.

0.7.6

  • Make WordPress.org Plugin Check annotations resilient to Freemius Free-package preprocessing.
  • Preserve translator guidance and narrow scanner/Freemius exceptions in the generated Free build.

0.7.5

  • Make the Freemius premium-only CSV export guard compiler-safe for Free-package generation.
  • Keep direct CSV export requests denied without a Pro entitlement.

0.7.4

  • Harden database-table initialization so Plugin Check demo-content preparation does not trigger missing-table errors.
  • Document Freemius bootstrap naming exceptions for WordPress coding standards.
  • Include composer.json in the WordPress.org-shaped CI build and align the generated test package version.

0.7.3

  • Default Freemius pricing and checkout to EUR.
  • Show annual plan totals instead of monthly equivalents on the pricing page.
  • Keep Freemius pricing pages under the WordPress Tools menu.

0.7.2

  • Harden the CSV entitlement boundary for Freemius-generated Free and Pro packages.
  • Add an automated regression test for direct CSV export access without Pro.

0.7.0

  • Integrate Freemius SDK 2.13.4 at the start of the main plugin bootstrap.
  • Add Free-to-Pro activation conflict handling and licensed distribution metadata.
  • Protect CSV review-report export behind an active ClaimPrism Pro entitlement.
  • Bundle the pinned SDK into CI test and WordPress.org-shaped build artifacts.

0.6.0

  • Rebrand the plugin as ClaimPrism before its first public WordPress.org submission.
  • Align the public plugin slug, text domain, REST namespace, extension hooks and development tooling with the ClaimPrism name.
